# `vl cat`

Print a file's content at a snapshot

```text
vl cat [OPTIONS] <PATH>
```

Arguments:

| | |
|---|---|
| `<PATH>` | File to print (required) |

Options:

| | |
|---|---|
| `-r, --rev <REV>` | Snapshot to read it from (default: `@`) |
